name: Story in 8 frames
blurb: A topic or script becomes eight frames with the same character, voiced and captioned.

beats.direction: an arresting opening image that makes the viewer stop
the everyday world before anything changes
the main character wanting something clearly
the problem standing in the way
the result, shown in one strong image
a calm closing image that invites the next step

style: cinematic still frame, vertical 9:16 composition, consistent lighting and colour palette, same main character in every frame
